```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  collapse = TRUE,
  comment = "#>"
)

library(ml4time2event)
library(dplyr)
library(recipes)
library(rsample)
library(survival)
```

## Survival pipelines

```{r}
lung <- get_lung_survival_data() |>
  mutate(status = if_else(status == 2, 1L, status))

surv_pipe <- ml4t2e_pipeline(
  outcome = list(type = "survival", time = "time", event = "status"),
  models = c("cox", "gbm"),
  ensemble = "auto",
  recipe = recipe(~., data = lung) |>
    step_impute_median(all_numeric_predictors()),
  resampling = vfold_cv(lung, v = 3)
)

surv_pipe$fit(lung)
surv_pipe$summary()
```

Predictions are tidy and time-aware:

```{r}
surv_preds <- surv_pipe$predict(
  newdata = lung[1:5, ],
  times = seq(0, 365, length.out = 25),
  type = "survival",
  include = "ensemble"
)

head(surv_preds)
```

## Competing-risk pipelines

```{r}
bmt <- get_bmt_competing_risks_data() |>
  mutate(
    cause = if_else(status == 0L, NA_integer_, status),
    status = if_else(status == 0L, 0L, 1L)
  )

cr_pipe <- ml4t2e_pipeline(
  outcome = list(
    type = "competing_risk",
    time = "ftime",
    status = "status",
    cause = "cause"
  ),
  models = c("cox", "cr_fine_gray"),
  ensemble = "auto"
)

cr_pipe$fit(bmt)
cr_pipe$summary()
```

Predictions return cumulative incidence functions in a tidy tibble:

```{r}
cr_preds <- cr_pipe$predict(
  newdata = bmt[1:4, ],
  times = seq(0, 120, length.out = 20),
  type = "cif",
  include = "ensemble"
)

head(cr_preds)
```

## Persistence

```{r}
tmp <- tempfile(fileext = ".rds")
saveRDS(surv_pipe, tmp)
reloaded <- readRDS(tmp)
reloaded$summary()
```
